nodes.role: CI/CD pipeline: daily cron + manual trigger that runs the Meta and GSC fetch scripts, then commits and pushes updated data files back to the repo.
constraints: requires secrets META_ACCESS_TOKEN, META_ACCOUNT_ID, META_ACCOUNT_ID_2, GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
job permissions: contents: write (needed to git push)

nodes.role: Python script: pulls Meta Marketing API campaign/ad insights for the Plume ad account, computes per-campaign results by optimization goal, writes data.json and downloads banner thumbnails.
constraints: only builds the Plume account (ACCOUNT_ID) in __main__; ACCOUNT_ID_2/'Matro' account is defined but never built here (fetch_meta.py:430-441)

nodes.role: Python script: pulls Google Search Console daily/monthly/query/page data; a URL-keyword category classifier producing weekly per-section position trends; a query-text classifier grouping ALL queries into brand/матраци/топери/дивани/ліжка/шафи buckets; and dated weekly position history (week_start-keyed) for the top 20 queries and top 20 pages by clicks. Writes all of it to seo_data.json.
constraints: requires env GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON or local gsc_key.json (fetch_gsc.py:20-22)
SITES = [{'id':'https://matroluxe.ua/','name':'Matroluxe UA'}] — URL-prefix property, only one site configured (fetch_gsc.py:46-49)
classify_category() keyword-matches URL slugs since the site has no /catalog/ path prefix — heuristic, may misclassify some product URLs (fetch_gsc.py:32-44)
classify_query() is also a keyword heuristic (brand names + product-type words in the query text) — same caveat as classify_category()

query/page weekly history is fetched fresh from the GSC API for the requested date range each run (not accumulated locally across runs) — GSC retains ~16 months of history, so no local persistence is needed
query_categories now embeds the full list of individual queries per category (not just aggregates) so the UI can drill down from a category into its keywords
also fetches a previous-28-day aggregate (no dimensions, single row) as 'prev_period', used by home.html to compute period-over-period trend

nodes.role: Data artifact: Meta Ads daily campaign rows + banner/ad rows, regenerated by fetch-meta and read by index.html and home.html.
constraints: schema: {generated_at, source, period, currency, daily[], banners[]} (fetch_meta.py:405-411)

nodes.role: Data artifact: GSC daily/monthly/query/page rows plus weekly category-position series, regenerated by fetch-gsc and read by seo.html and home.html. Not present in the current checkout — the fetch workflow has not yet completed a successful run that reaches the write step.
constraints: schema: {generated_at, sites:[{site_url, site_name, period, daily[], monthly[], queries[], pages[], categories[]}]} (fetch_gsc.py:121-160, 218-225)

nodes.role: SMM & Реклама dashboard: campaign table (goal-type multi-select, sortable, totals), banner-effectiveness tab, 3 day-by-day charts, and an AI-insights panel.
constraints: account switcher includes a 'Matro' tab wired to fetch data2.json (index.html:238), but no script in this repo writes data2.json — likely stale/unused UI path
cost-per-lead color coding (cheap/mid/expensive) computed relative to the average within campaign type (function cplClass)

nodes.role: SEO dashboard: per-site tabs, daily/monthly period toggle, 4 KPI cards, daily clicks bar chart, weekly category position-dynamics line chart, a query-category breakdown (brand vs product type), and top-queries/top-pages tables where each row shows a dated 12-week position sparkline (hover for the exact weekly values) instead of a single static number. The query-category bars are clickable — selecting one opens a table of every keyword in that category.
constraints: fails open with a visible error box if seo_data.json is missing or invalid JSON (seo.html: load()/showError())

nodes.role: Navigation hub / operations-center overview: dark glassmorphism theme, live system-status pills (Meta Ads, GSC), and two summary cards (SMM, SEO) with sparkline charts, linking out to index.html and seo.html. Each card also shows a period-over-period trend badge (SMM: leads, last 30d vs previous 30d computed client-side from data.json's 90-day history; SEO: clicks, last 28d vs prev_period from seo_data.json).
entrypoints: loadSMM() and loadSEO() called at script end (home.html)
constraints: ONLINE/OFFLINE status pills are derived purely from whether the corresponding fetch() succeeds, not from any real health-check endpoint (home.html: setSys())

nodes.role: Meta Marketing Graph API (v21.0) — source of ad account campaign/ad insights and creative thumbnails.
Google Search Console API (searchAnalytics.query) — source of search performance data for matroluxe.ua.

Cloudflare Worker called by index.html to generate AI analysis text for the campaigns/banners tabs. Its internal implementation (e.g. which model API it calls) is outside this repo and is not evidenced here — marked unknown.
constraints: response shape consumed as data.content[0].text (index.html genInsights()) — unknown what produces that shape server-side

nodes.role: Static third-party assets used by home.html: Inter font (Google Fonts) and Lucide icon library (unpkg CDN).
Static hosting that serves index.html, seo.html, and home.html (plus data.json/seo_data.json) directly from the repo's main branch root.
